scope: Same-input public Python CASA 6.7.6.14 / casaplotms 2.9.1 and casa-rs. Select the named baseline in a two-field, five-scan MS with different observation values and SOURCE rows. Export all scan and field pages, the PHASE selection, the observation date/time, telescope and two-ordinate labels, and a single page with no matching SOURCE. Repeat the Y-column header for a vector residual and explicit and effective FLOAT_DATA, and the observation start for a selected TAI row.
baseline_result: Native public PlotMS refuses the named baseline when listobs resolves its page headers, before producing a figure. The earlier header implementation used an axis-title token for a vector residual and read a selected TAI observation start as UTC.
